verses.text: After Aaron’s two sons died for approaching Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Moses again: 🕯️

Yahweh told Moses, ‘Tell your brother Aaron he can’t just walk into the Most Holy Place whenever. Behind that curtain, before the ark’s atonement cover, he could die. I appear in a cloud above the cover. ⚠️
‘When Aaron does enter the sanctuary, he must bring a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering. 🐂
He must put on the holy linen tunic and underclothes, tie the linen sash, and wear the linen turban. That’s the holy outfit; first he must bathe in water, then put it on. 🧼
He must get from Israel’s community two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering. 🐐
‘Aaron must offer the bull as his own sin offering, making atonement for himself and his household first. 🙏
He must bring both goats before Yahweh at the Meeting Tent entrance. 🐐
Aaron must cast lots to decide the goats’ roles: one lot for Yahweh, the other for the scapegoat. 🎲
Aaron must bring forward the goat picked by lot for Yahweh and offer it as a sin offering. 🐐
But the goat picked as the scapegoat must be brought alive before Yahweh, for atonement, then sent out into the wilderness. 🏜️
‘Aaron must bring his bull for the sin offering, make atonement for himself and his household, then slaughter that bull for his own offering. 🐂
He must take a fire pan loaded with burning coals from Yahweh’s altar, plus two handfuls of finely crushed fragrant incense, and carry them behind the curtain. 🔥
He must put the incense on the fire before Yahweh; its cloud must cover the atonement cover over the covenant, so he won’t die. ☁️
He must take some bull’s blood and flick it with his finger on the east side of the atonement cover, then flick blood in front of the cover seven times. 🩸
‘Next, he must slaughter the people’s sin-offering goat, carry its blood behind the curtain, and sprinkle it on and in front of the atonement cover, same as with the bull’s blood. 🐐
He must make atonement for the Most Holy Place because Israel is ritually unclean and has rebelled and sinned. Do the same for the Meeting Tent, standing right among them and their uncleanness. 🙏
Nobody else can be in the Meeting Tent while Aaron goes in to make atonement in the sanctuary. He comes back out only after making atonement for himself, his household, and all Israel. 🚪
‘Then Aaron must go out to the altar before Yahweh and make atonement for it, putting some bull’s blood and goat’s blood around the altar horns. 🩸
He must flick blood onto the altar with his finger seven times, cleansing it and setting it apart from Israel’s uncleanness. 🔁
‘Once Aaron has made atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Meeting Tent, and the altar, he must bring out the live goat. 🐐

Aaron must put both hands on the live goat’s head and confess over it every wrong, rebellion, and sin Israel has done. He puts all of that on the goat’s head, then sends it into the wilderness with a man assigned to take it. 🗣️
The goat carries all their wrongs away to a remote land; the man must let it go out there in the wilderness. 🏜️
‘Aaron must go back into the Meeting Tent, take off the linen clothes he wore into the sanctuary, and leave them there. 👘
He must bathe in water at a holy place, put on his regular clothes, come out, and offer his burnt offering and the people’s—making atonement for himself and them. 🧼
The sin offering’s fat must go up in flames on the altar. 🔥
‘The man who lets the scapegoat go must wash his clothes and bathe in water; after that, he can return to camp. 🚿
The bull and goat used for sin offerings—their blood brought into the sanctuary for atonement—must be hauled outside camp. Burn their hides, meat, and dung in the fire. 🔥
Whoever burns them must wash their clothes and bathe in water; then they can head back to camp. 🧼
‘This rule stands for all time: on day ten of month seven, deny yourselves and do no work—whether you were born here or are a foreigner living among you. 📅
On this day atonement will be made to cleanse you; before Yahweh, you’ll be clean from all your sins. 🙏
It’s a Sabbath of deep rest for you; deny yourselves. This rule stays in place. 🕊️
The priest anointed and set apart to take his father’s place must make atonement, wearing the holy linen clothes. 👑
He must make atonement for the Most Holy Sanctuary, the Meeting Tent, the altar, the priests, and everybody gathered there. 🙏
‘This rule lasts: once every year, atonement must be made for Israel because of all their sins.’ And Moses did exactly as Yahweh commanded. 📜
